contexts.text: Seventy times () = what is much more a sacrilege.

The number seventy, which comprehends seven ages (derives its signification from seven), and when anything most holy, or most sacred, was to be expressed, it was said seventy times seven... which means to forgive as many times as he sins, so that it should be without end, or eternal, which is holy.
Thus seventy times seven, here, = damnation.
The seventy years of the captivity = the (end of vastation and the beginning of a new man); for seventy and seven involve the same thing.
Abraham was a son of five years and seventy years () = not so much of the Divine; five = little, and seventy = what is holy; here, being predicated of the Lord, seventy = the holy Divine.
Seventy years () = an entire period, from the time at which the Church began even till it expires. The seventy years of the captivity involves something similar.
Seventy () = what is full in order.

Seventy days () = a full state; for seventy involves the like as seven, which = an entire period from beginning to end, thus a full state; for multiplied numbers = the like as the simple ones of which they are composed.
That seventy = an entire period, thus a full state. Illustrated.
Seventy years () = a full state of desolation and devastation: this was signified by the seventy years of the captivity.
Seventy weeks () manifestly stands for a full state, thus for an entire period before the Lord would come; hence it is said that He came in the fulness of time. Explained.
Seventy palm trees () = goods of truth in all abundance; seventy = all things in the complex, in like manner as twelve.
Seventy in like manner = what is full.
Seventy of the elders of Israel () = the chief truths of the Church (all) concordant with good. Seventy = what is full, thus all things. ( = all who are in good from truths. AC 9404.)
Seventy weeks = the time and state of the Church with the Jews down to its end; for seven, and seventy = what is full from beginning to end.
